schema:
CREATE TABLE nodes (node_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT);
CREATE TABLE edges (src_id INTEGER, dst_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (src_id, dst_id), FOREIGN KEY (src_id) REFERENCES nodes (node_id), FOREIGN KEY (dst_id) REFERENCES nodes (node_id));
correct_query: SELECT deg FROM (SELECT src_id, COUNT(*) AS deg FROM edges GROUP BY src_id) ORDER BY deg

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Drops ORDER BY on derived-table COUNT(*) alias when grouping by one column of a composite PK whose columns reference the same parent PK
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edges GROUP BY src_id
